function.name: fetch_user_details
function.description: Retrieves details of a user from the database based on the provided user identification criteria. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

user_id.description: The unique identifier of the user.

include_address.description: Specifies whether to include the user's address information in the response.

date_format.description: The format in which to return any date fields, such as 'YYYY-MM-DD' or 'MM/DD/YYYY'.

fields.description: A list of additional field names to include in the response, such as ['email', 'phone_number'].

message.content:
抱歉，我目前无法直接访问实时天气数据。您可以通过以下方式快速获取武汉的最新天气信息：

1. **天气网站**  
   - [中国天气网](https://www.weather.com.cn)  
   - [AccuWeather](https://www.accuweather.com/zh-cn/city/zh/wuhan/101210101)  
   - [Weather.com](https://weather.com/zh-CN/weather/today/l/101210101)

2. **手机应用**  
   - 微信小程序“天气”  
   - “墨迹天气”  
   - “彩云天气”

3. **语音助手**  
   - 说“嘿，小爱同学，武汉今天几度？”或“嘿，Siri，武汉天气怎么样？”

如果您需要更详细的天气预报（如未来7天、空气质量指数等），建议使用上述网站或应用，它们会提供完整的气象信息。祝您生活愉快！
message.reasoning: The user says "获取武汉的天气" which means "Get the weather of Wuhan". We need to provide weather info. There's no tool for weather. We can respond with a placeholder or say we don't have real-time data. We can ask if they want approximate or use external API? We can provide a general answer: "I don't have real-time data, but you can check a weather website." So respond accordingly.
